method: tools.mjs verify: each quote matched against the cached text of its own source after normalising Unicode compatibility forms, quotes, dashes, whitespace and PDF line-break hyphenation (Chinese text also without whitespace; as a last resort without hyphens, for printed line-break hyphens lost in a text layer); "…" joins fragments that must occur in order. Word limits per quote (50; Chinese 100 characters) and per source (editorial policy), counting the dataset’s existing quotes from the same source expression.
